criteria.primary_unit: Current paired case block, source-ID retention row, and declared fixed-pool presentation; diagnostic and fresh strata separate. Shared cases/controls are not independent across studies.

usefulness.0: No decision-relevant mechanism or discriminating question under the valued outcome
usefulness.1: Potentially useful, bounded decision/probe relevance with explicit assumptions
usefulness.2: Clear decision-relevant mechanism or feasible discriminator under supplied resources; still unexecuted

observability.1: Observable prediction without a different result from a nearest plausible rival
observability.2: Source-linked different predictions with feasible bounded probe and defeat condition

fit.preserves: Proposal/probe respects all hard constraints under supplied resources
fit.conditional: Explicitly requires relaxing a hard constraint

novelty.new: Locally distinct causal operation or discriminating question relative to supplied archive
novelty.parameter: Only magnitude/wording/timing variant without new causal test
novelty.uncertain: Equivalence or causal distinction cannot be resolved

criteria.retained_qualification: raw qualification plus neutral D retention retained; D-only additions excluded from raw gain
criteria.equivalence: case-local operation + carrier + causal path + expected discriminator; words/labels insufficient; uncertain links kept, never transitive forced merge
criteria.comparison: Within each block qualified A/Q raw families versus primary comparator; secondary overlap with all intelligible concurrent ordinary+creative raw families including uncertain equivalence links. Shared Z overlap separately. Raw execution/review incompleteness gates raw exclusivity; D loss does not erase raw generation. Post-only additions attributed separately.

p08: case-local distinction versus other arm and archive
review.coverage: two independent reviews per unit/pair with exact matrix and row IDs; saved calls do not imply coverage
review.adjudication: At most one scalar-only adjudication permaincase and perP08/P09batch, only declared differences with type/enum validation; agreed scalars exact. Family membership disputes conservatively unresolved, no forced merges.
review.blinding: administrative method and job names replaced by opaque IDs; semantic content and causal evidence preserved; recognizability can remain
review.stage_completeness: raw_assessment_complete and raw_execution_valid distinct from post_assessment_complete and execution_valid. A failed/missing D yields retention unobservable, does not erase valid raw dual coverage; gates retention/P10.
review.failure_gates: Missing/invalid independent review preserves source candidates with null semantic assessments in separate gated reports; all planned units/pairs/rankings disposed explicitly. Do not claim zero novelty.

ordinary_key: raw order Z1,Z2,A1,A2,Q1,Q2 then lexical raw ID
p10.ordinary: first two retained distinct families, stable ID tie break
p10.eligible: intelligible,new,usefulness>=1,fit preserves,observability2,retained,resolved,confirmed family,support not unsupported; reuse locked fields, no additional semantic assessment
p10.alternative: ordinary first slot unchanged; highest-ranked eligible candidate family distinct from first and without uncertain-equivalence link; ordinary second fallback if none
p10.gates: complete execution + two-review coverage + locked judgments/equivalence; otherwise not_evaluable with cause, never zero exposure
p10.conservation: identical candidate set and fixed assessments, entering/displaced fields, family exposure, utility displacement, violations and text burden; no better human decision inference
p10.semantic_contract_policy: Deliberately independent from raw operator-success qualification: a useful distinct retained mechanism may qualify despite partial/not_met operator form. Report entering/displaced candidate contract statuses separately. This cannot credit the generating operator with semantic success. Null/unresolved contract is ineligible. Historical contract field unavailable uses original locked rubric.

burden.meaning: Saved words/native role calls are proxies. Actual tokens/internal calls unknown. Full exact coverage precedes brevity; overage reported, never silently truncated.
burden.prospective_change: Before first G native launch; exact raw/post/pair/addition assessment matrix. See generation-review-contract.v2.json. Original I01/I09 criteria remain immutable.

criteria.retry_policy: zero scored retries; failed dependency skips retained in denominators; unscored code/preflight repair before freeze allowed
criteria.claim_ceiling: Supplied synthetic facts, model proposals, model assessments and deterministic presentation outcomes separate; physical/operational/human-decision tests unexecuted.
criteria.study_contracts: inputs/plan/portfolio.json; explicit phase dependencies and zero scored retries apply. I11 final is three-stage raw generation, no compression.
criteria.p09_fit_policy: Source fidelity preserves declared raw status; inherited source-category conflict is separately reported, not counted as a new compression addition. Operational/probe fit may remain uncertain despite source-stipulated proposal fit.

contract.scope: I02-I08 exact matched case block including every shared seed/concern, raw/convergence, summary, optional addition and prior-ID disposition. Not a full Robot Talks evaluation.
contract.row_identity: Blinded packet expected_matrix declares exact row IDs. Every identity once; no omissions of empty/invalid/skipped units. Prefix raw/summary IDs with opaque unit ID. All case-local raw card pairs and raw×ordinary-archive pairs explicit. Semantic equivalence disputes remain uncertain, never scalar-adjudicated into forced families.
contract.raw_qualification: Same frozen criteria scalar meanings: intelligible true, novelty new, usefulness>=1, observability2, fit preserves, support not unsupported, contract met, family_confirmed true, independently resolved. Feasible probe resources must be source-supported; no physical/human measured success inferred. Shared seed/concern can establish overlap but is not attributed as treatment discovery.
contract.protected_retention: Relation and full prediction/probe including all rivals, directional comparisons, challenge/defeat and capacity/resource caveats; uncertainty and declared fit. Summaries may have six post cards per two raw cards; evaluate all post IDs, every raw source and exact lineage. Faithful inherited raw errors are separate from new summary assertions. Park/reject disposition may preserve protected content in its reason; absent targets alone do not prove loss.
contract.unit_contract: Apply only the assigned per-unit instruction; ordinary/generic controls are not required to perform the treatment. Honest no viable opening is a valid execution result, not a discovery or zero-valued missing assessment. Distinguish raw completeness from summary completeness.
contract.family_assessment: Judge all explicit archive/candidate pairs from causal operation, carrier/path and prediction/test, not words. family_confirmed only if relevant comparisons resolve. Same-family overlap prevents exclusivity even if comparator fit/contract is partial. Preserve uncertain links and no forced transitive merges.

burden.prospective_change: I05 maximal complete matrix exceeds200 obligations at max6 summaries and max2 additions per arm; provide6000 before any scored generation, retain original allowance and first blocked preflight. All arms/reviewers identical; actual cost reported. Native unscored maximal matrix still required before admission.
burden.shard: one complete case block per independent review
burden.review_calls: two per case, one bounded scalar adjudicator maximum; no retries

contract.adjudication: Exact differences of scalar grades only; freeze agreed scalars. Pair/family differences retain uncertain; no family merges. One native scalar-only turn per case max. Invalid review and dependency skips keep source IDs and null judgments, never zero novelty.
contract.phase_gate: Own-study pilot findings must be locked before confirmation. Negative/unresolved outcomes are preserved and can be confirmed where portfolio allows; explicit eliminate/stop rules dispose dependent roles as skipped. No output-conditioned case selection.

contract.scope: I02-I08 exact matched case block including every shared seed/concern, raw/convergence, summary, optional addition and prior-ID disposition. Not a full Robot Talks evaluation.

contract.protected_retention: Relation and full prediction/probe including all rivals, directional comparisons, challenge/defeat and capacity/resource caveats; uncertainty and declared fit. contract.unit_contract: Apply only the assigned per-unit instruction; ordinary/generic controls are not required to perform the treatment. Honest no viable opening is a valid execution result, not a discovery or zero-valued missing assessment. Distinguish raw completeness from summary completeness.
contract.family_assessment: Judge all explicit archive/candidate pairs from causal operation, carrier/path and prediction/test, not words. family_confirmed only if relevant comparisons resolve.
